messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Additional dose increases may be considered after several more weeks if insufficient clinical improvement is observed. The recommended dose range is 20 mg to 60 mg per day.
Lower-weight children: Treatment starts at 10 mg/day with dose increases after several more weeks if there is a lack of clinical improvement. The recommended dose range of 20 mg to 30 mg per day, although experience with daily doses greater than 20 mg is very minimal,
Bulimia Nervosa:
Adult dose: The recommended dose is 60 mg once daily in the morning. Your doctor may gradually increase your dose to this level over several days. Clinical trials showed that the 60 mg dose was effective in reducing binge-eating and purging behaviors.
Panic Disorder:
Triplet: ["Fluoxetine", "has clinical effectiveness", "reduces binge-eating and purging behaviors at 60 mg dose"]

The relation 'has clinical effectiveness' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug demonstrates effectiveness in reducing the specified symptoms or behaviors at the dose mentioned in the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has dose adjustment note': A note regarding the effectiveness or clinical impact of a specific dose of the subject drug is provided in the context of the object entity.
B. 'has onset of effect': The subject drug starts to work or shows its effect within the time period specified by the object entity.
C. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
D. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
